dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Question: FPT Algorithm for Graph Isomorphism Parameterized by Clique-Width
dossier_meta.statement_text: Whether an FPT algorithm exists for Graph Isomorphism when parameterized by clique-width is still open.
dossier_meta.context_text: Lokshtanov et al. [23] gave an FPT algorithm parameterized by treewidth, and Grohe and Schweitzer [20] proved XP membership parameterized by clique-width (i.e., polynomial-time solvability for each fixed clique-width). The question of whether the parameter clique-width admits an FPT algorithm remains unresolved.
